title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 33
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 33: the watchman and the trumpet, the call to turn and live, and the news that the city had been defeated.

questions.text: What does the watchman do when he sees the sword come on the land?
questions.explanation: The chapter says that if he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people.

answers.text: He blows the trumpet
He shuts the gates
He lights a fire
He runs to the king

questions.text: What happens to the one who hears the trumpet but does not heed the warning?
questions.explanation: It says that whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and does not heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

answers.text: He is carried away to Babylon
He is judged by the elders of the land
His blood will be on his own head
He is saved by the watchman anyway

questions.text: What happens if the watchman sees the sword come and does not blow the trumpet?
questions.explanation: It says the person taken away is taken in his iniquity, but his blood will be required at the watchman's hand.

answers.text: The people are warned by others
The blood is required at the watchman's hand
The sword turns back from the land
The watchman loses his place at the wall

questions.text: What was the son of man set to be for the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: He says: I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel; therefore hear the word from my mouth and give them warnings from me.

answers.text: A priest
A judge
A shepherd
A watchman

questions.text: In what does the Lord Yahweh say he has no pleasure?
questions.explanation: He says: I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live.

answers.text: In the death of the wicked
In the offerings of the people
In the silence of the prophets
In the sword of the nations

questions.text: Which three things does the chapter say the wicked does who will surely live?
questions.explanation: It says that if the wicked restores the pledge, gives back what he had taken by robbery, and walks in the statutes of life committing no iniquity, he will surely live.

answers.text: He builds an altar, brings a lamb and pays a tithe
He leaves the city, crosses the river and hides in a cave
He restores the pledge, gives back what he robbed and walks in the statutes
He calls the elders, confesses his sin and fasts for a day

questions.text: What news did the man who had escaped out of Jerusalem bring?
questions.explanation: In the twelfth year of their captivity, in the tenth month, on the fifth day, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came and said: the city has been defeated!

answers.text: That the king had fled
That the city has been defeated
That the sanctuary was rebuilt
That the sword had turned back

questions.text: What did those who inhabit the waste places say about Abraham?
questions.explanation: They said: Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many, the land is given us for inheritance.

answers.text: That he was one and inherited the land
That he built an altar in the land
That he was driven out of the land
That he bought the land for silver

questions.text: What does the chapter say would happen to those in the strongholds and in the caves?
questions.explanation: It says those in the waste places will fall by the sword, those in the open field will be given to the animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die of the pestilence.

answers.text: They would be carried into captivity
They would be saved from the sword
They would die of the pestilence
They would be scattered among the nations

questions.text: What was the prophet to the people who heard his words but did not do them?
questions.explanation: It says he is to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice and can play well on an instrument, for they hear his words but do not do them.

answers.text: As a sword in the hand of a mighty man
As a lamp burning in a dark house
As a cloud passing over the mountains
As a very lovely song
